question: Is there an FDA-listed pregnancy exposure registry covering topiramate? Give the listing and registry contact or enrollment link if returned, and distinguish finding a registry from being eligible to enroll.
criteria: Only return actually listed registry/link/status; no invented enrollment or FDA endorsement. Registry team determines eligibility and current participation. Empty directory search is not proof no registry exists.
answer:
Yes. The FDA directory lists **The North American Antiepileptic Drug in Pregnancy Registry** for **Topamax, Trokendi XR, and Qudexy XR (topiramate)**, for epilepsy, mood disorder, and migraine headaches. Its status is listed as **Ongoing**. [S2](https://www.fda.gov/consumers/pregnancy-exposure-registries/list-pregnancy-exposure-registries)

- **Enrollment/contact:** https://www.aedpregnancyregistry.org/join-our-study/ [S1](https://www.aedpregnancyregistry.org/join-our-study/)
- **Telephone:** 1-888-233-2334 [S1](https://www.aedpregnancyregistry.org/join-our-study/)

This listing does **not** establish individual eligibility or current site availability. The study team must confirm both directly. The FDA directory also states that it lists but does not operate or endorse the registries, and that the list is not comprehensive. [S2](https://www.fda.gov/consumers/pregnancy-exposure-registries/list-pregnancy-exposure-registries)
